subject: Exit snapshots, training verification & sample redacted vetting artifacts
messages:
From: Gael Ortega <gael.ortega@woodfordcap.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: security@woodfordcap.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample artifacts for offboarding & training verification (SOC 2 scoping)

Evelyn,

Thanks again for taking the time on the call this morning. As part of Woodford's SOC 2 scoping we need a small set of evidentiary samples to validate Redwood's personnel controls. Can you provide the following as redacted samples: 

- 3 redacted background check results (different roles, one contractor)
- Training completion extract for the last 12 months (CSV or PDF) showing required security modules and timestamps
- Deprovisioning/exit checklist entries for 2 recent leavers (audit trail preferred)

A couple of constraints from our side: PII must be redacted at least to initials + hiring date (we will accept HTML/PDF redaction). Team prefers a CSV manifest mapping sample files to control IDs (e.g., HR-ON/HR-OFF). If you can include a short note describing your redaction approach that would be helpful.

Ideal delivery by next Thursday 2026-03-12. If that timeline is tight, send what you have and we can prioritize.

Regards,

Gael Ortega
Sr. Information Security Manager
Woodford Capital
security@woodfordcap.com

[attachment: woodford-soc2-questionnaire-v2.pdf (ref)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Gael Ortega <gael.ortega@woodfordcap.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for offboarding & training verification (SOC 2 scoping)

Gael —

Appreciate the clarity. We can provide the requested redacted samples and a brief attestation on our redaction process. Plan below: 

1) Deliver redacted-bg-sample.zip (3 samples: one contractor, two full-time) with a manifest mapping to controls HR-1, HR-2, HR-7.
2) training-completion-extract.pdf (exported from LMS, includes user id, course id, module, completion timestamp).
3) evidence-manifest.csv that links each file to the control id and the date range.
4) Deprovisioning snapshots: will include two audit logs showing account disable + ticket id from our identity provider.

We will ensure names are redacted to initials and employee IDs replaced with a per-sample proxy (e.g., EID-xx), and include a short redaction note. For the contractor sample, the employment type field will remain but vendor company name redacted.

Delivery target: EOD Tue 2026-03-10 (gives us time to run redactions and HR sign-off). If you can confirm that timeline works, we'll proceed.

Also looping in Ben (security ops) and Karthik (HR programs) to help assemble logs and redactions. Lauren — can you coordinate the export from the LMS and hand-off the raw files to Ben?

Thanks,

--
Evelyn Hart

Subject: Fwd: Request: sample artifacts for offboarding & training verification (SOC 2 scoping)

Gael —

Attached are the initial deliverables (manifest + three redacted background samples + training extract). The ZIP contains a README that documents the redaction rules we applied and the origin system for each artifact. Quick notes: 

- redacted-bg-sample.zip (contains 3 PDFs; contractor sample labeled PROXY-CTR-01)
- training-completion-extract.pdf (filtered 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01; includes completion timestamps and module IDs)
- evidence-manifest.csv (maps file -> control id -> system -> internal ticket)

We've redacted to initials + hire month/year and replaced internal IDs with EID-xx tokens. HR reviewed the artifacts and signed off on the redaction README. For the deprovisioning artifacts you requested (audit trail), those are exportable but contain internal network identifiers; Ben has provided sanitized snapshots and will deliver a separate ticketed export if you need the raw log references.

If you'd like, we can run one of the redacted items through your team in a short live call to validate redaction level before we hand over the rest. Otherwise, consider this the first tranche; we'll provide the deprovisioning snapshots by end of week per Ben's note.

Link to manifest and downloads: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/woodford/audit-2026/evidence-manifest

Regards,

--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
